tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yon gnas dam pa rnams la bsngags pa'i rim pa dpa' bo'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (1ba2)༄༅// rtsa ba'i bla ma la bstod pa/ 'di dang phyi ma dus thams cad kyi skyabs gnas rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dge legs bye ba'i chu klung 'du ba'i gzhi// snying rje'i rba rlabs rgyas pa'i 'phreng ba can// snying stobs chu gter khyod la rtag par bdag /dad pa'i me tog 'thor ro ngag gi dbang*// phun tshogs ngo mtshar mā la ya rlung gis// 'khyud pa grub pa'i tsan dan 'khri shing khyod// skye bo'i gdung sel mchog tu 'dir grags na// phan bde'i grib bsil sbyin zhig ngag gi dbang*// lung rtogs nor bu'i bang mdzod bye ba brgyar// dbang 'byor dge ba'i bshes gnyen nor sbyin gyi// sde dpon dbus na khyod nyid rnams thos bur// grags pa'i gdugs dkar bsgrengs so ngag gi dbang*// rmad byung gdams pa 'dab brgya'i ge sar gyi// sbrang rtsi gsar pas skal bzang bung ba'i yid// kun dgar byed pa khyod mtshungs med pa'i gtam// brjod pas 'gro rnams brel to ngag gi dbang*// rnam kun stong pa'i dga' mar bde chen gyis// mngon par 'khyud pa'i rtse dga'i dpal yon can// khyod nyid rtag par dgyes pa'i 'dun se */ yid can thams cad drongs shig ngag gi dbang*// rigs can gsum la mos dbang ji bzhin du// sku gsung thugs kyi snang brnyan 'char ba yi// grangs rjes 'jug der rgyal rnams rmongs gyur ba'i// ngo mtshar yongs kyi byed po ngag gi dbang*// srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma tshang med gsal ba// khyod kyi rnam thar rmad byung me long las// gzhan du phun tshogs 'tshol ba'i gti mug can// thugs rje'i gzigs pa ma gtong ngag gi dbang*// dregs ldan ral pa'i nam mkha' la chags pa'i// khyod zhabs gsar pa'i zla tshes (2na3)rnyog bral nges// grub pa'i gnas la mngon 'dod mgrin sngon pa'i// zur phud phun tshogs mdzod cig ngag gi dbang*// dad pa'i phyag dang lhan cig sbyar ba'o/// /de la bsre 'pho dang mthun par bstod pa// dpal 'brug pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rab dkar bstan 'dzin chu bya'i 'phreng ba las// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi chu klung rnams// nges gsang 'o mar 'thungs bas grub rigs kyi// dad pa'i ded dpon 'ba' zhig bsngags par 'os// ngag dbang 'bigs byed dga' mas chos kyi dbyangs// rna ba'i bcud du blangs tshe rgyal rnams dang*// yid kyi 'dod pa mtshungs pa'i mgrin sngon des// ci yang dang ba'i bstod tshig ca cor bgyis// dngos po'i gnas lugs bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor// lam du sbyangs pas rab gtsang 'bras bu yi// za ma tog 'ching gnyis pa med pa'i bshes// 'jam mgon 'brug pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs rtsa rlung thig le'i sbyin gyi 'phreng*// las nyon chu ris 'khrug des bgos dus kyang*// rang bzhin kun gsal mdzes ma sgrib bral ba// rang rig phyag chen mdza' bos yid ches mdzad// dad pa'i 'jug ngogs khyod drin 'bab stegs su// dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsis bkrus pa'i dag byed mthu// mthong bas khengs bral gang gā'i lha mo gang*// sa 'og zhugs ngogs gser mngal skrag pa 'dzin// bskyed rim mdzub rtse'i sen mo'i kha mtshon gyis// tha mal snang zhen mes po'i gdod bcad pa'i// las sbyangs dag pa gsum gyi brtul zhugs can// rab 'byams 'phrin las grub pas brdar ba'ang bstan// mthar byed gtum mo'i me des srid pa gsum// bsregs nas li khri'i 'od khyod stong bzhi'i mkhar// mnal ba dngas ma'i khams bzhi'i glus bskul nas// sad tshe rags bral 'ja' tshon zol gyis rol// dus me'i mche bas nyi ma'i dbugs zos pa'i// dmar ba'i khrag rgyun gyis gsher snying rje'i (2ba4)che// gang ba'i zla ba gtsug tor mkhar bros tshe// sgrib pa'i ri bod skyo nas srid par 'phyan// rang byin rlabs pa'i grags snyan ga pur gyis// rnam shes phyogs kyi bzhin ras dkar byas khyod// gnyis snang sgyu mas co 'dir ma nus pas// sgyu ma'i mkhyen por dag pa'i rab byung byin// nyi ma'i khu bas smin pa longs spyod kyi// 'dab brgya'i btung bas rab myos sbrang rtsi'i bu// rmi lam yul la rtse dga'i 'phur lding mthar// de nyid nam mkhar khyod gsung bsir bus bcug

/kun rtog yid srubs 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi// dbang por bkur 'os min zhes srid tshul la// khros pa khyod dbugs mes bsreg mngon byang gi/ ral pa'i nags der gnyid stug zla ba 'ang bcings// dpung pas srid las rnam rgyal bar ngo'i gshed// lang ka'i dbang po'i rgyu shes bskyed rdzogs mda'// rnam gsum mgrin dbus bsnun pa'i mthar byed gang*// 'phod mkhas rnam grol sī ta'i gnyen khyod yin// gong du 'pho ba'i gom pa gcig kho nas// mkha' spyod che mnan de tshe ring ba'i lam// stobs ldan bden min tshig gis zhum pa'i sar// bstim 'di gsang chen sred med bu yi g.yo// rga ba'i skabs gsum rdzab ldan rdzing dor nas// lus gsar gshol med lto ba'i thang zhugs kyang*// srog la chags pa tshe yi bzhin pad ni// 'chi ba'i ba mos ma regs mtshan skyes// rim 'jug lam gyi gdong lngas rjes gzung ba'i// thar pa'i nags 'dir dang po'i las can gyi// ri skyes phrug gu bag phabs rtse 'jo'i dpyid// dbang rnon thub pa'i sras la mgron pa'ang sbyar// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs gsum dri med shal// ma lus 'gro ba'i yid rjes 'brangs ma'i mdangs// dag pa'i spyan mkhar stong nyid nyi char gyis// spel ba las gzhan mtshon pa'i dpe gzhan ci// zhes rje btsun ngag gi dbang po la sre 'pho dang mthun par bstod pa padma dkar pos rgyal khabs rin spungs su dbyangs su byas pa'o/// /de'i skyes pa'i dbang (3na5)la bstod pa/ 'brug pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal rnams 'dus na dus mthu gtad de khyod// gsang ba'i bdag por dpang bskur la khros pa'i// dbang phyug gshed phral ro yis zhabs btud pas// thal ba'i dbyangs kyi sangs rgyas sbyin zhes grags// thos pa bdud rtsi'i char kun dran pa'i skyogs// 'dzin pa'i mchog bsngags kun dga' bo yi lce// ston pa'i 'dzum rtser chags pa lung ston pa'i// 'od kyi snal ma'i ro de myang ba'ang sprul// zla bzang gsol btab nyi mas zas gtsang bu'i// pa'i gnam sngon bzhub ma brjed pa// utpal rtser khengs ral gri sham bha lir// bsgyur bas mi shes rigs rnams brlag pa'ang mdzad// mi 'khrugs yon tan kun gyi bung ba'i 'phreng*// 'thibs pa rgyal sras spos kyi glang chen khyod// chos 'khod shing 'i srol 'byed gnyis pa ru// mngon dga' ku sha'i thang du 'khyams rnams gleng*// thar pa'i sa la 'gro ba dbugs 'byin pa'i// drang drong zhabs sen mdangs des u rgyan gyi// rol pa mos zur pud nor bu'i gzi// mog por bgyis kyang snying gi mun pa bral// 'dod pa'i yul la ci dga'i ḍombhi pa// stong nyid thod par snying rje'i khrag 'thungs nas// sta gzhon sbrul gyis brgyan pa g.yung mo yi// rtse dga'i 'khri shing de yang khyod kyi rdzu// thub pa'i bden tshig smin pa rdo 'jog gzhir// gtsug lag khang dang bstan la mchod pa'i sprin// kun bzang rnam thar mtshon pa'i 'ol spyi yang*// ma dran byed por rmongs sbyin khrir la'ang khyod// bka' babs bzhis bskul btsun mo'i mtshams sbyor gyis// rdo rje 'chang gi lung thob til brdung de'i// snyan ma phyogs kun ri dgas mig can mas// rna ba'i rgyan du srid pa'i ring 'dir phrogs// dbus 'gyur shar rir thub pa'i nyi ma bzhin// legs bshad 'od zer 'bum gzung gangs can pa'i// snying gi ge sar skal bzang gser zhun la// btso blag mkhan khyod (3ba6)mtshan yang mar par bsgyur// nyon yid ce sbyang rang rig dbugs bral la// mchod par snyems khrel nyams rtogs dar ma'i dpyid// seng ges bgad tshe rtog ge'i gnyis 'thud snying*// lkog ma'i zas 'gran pa'i zol gyis bros// ngag dbang bdud rtsi'i chu gter gyis spros pa'i// chos kyi rnga sgra'i ro rnams bstan 'dzin lha'i// 'dun sar skyugs tshe rgyal ba nor lha'i bu// legs so'i me tog 'phreng ba khyod la 'ching*// 'khor bar gnon pa rtog pa'i ngan sngags mkhan// dang gshed dbab pas bsgral nas khyab gdal ba'i// phyag chen dbyings su 'dren pas khyod dang ni// padma 'byung gnas tha dad gang gis dbye// sdang bas rtsub pa 'jam par byed pa'i brdar// 'dod pa'i tshad gdung phyir bzlog gzur rgyun// gti mug ri bo bsnyil ba rdo rje dang*// mtshungs pas 'brel tshad don ldan khyod min su// khyod gsung nyams ldan 'khyog po'i ros sim pas// dbyangs can mgrin par byed rnams brtan pa'i ri// bsgral 'dod snyigs dus smra ba'i phye ma leb// 'dod pa gshog rtse'i rlung sbyor bzhad ba gang rgyu// bdag sems mkhar 'dres rje yi zla ba khyod// gzhan ma mtshan mo'i don mdzad bsnyel tam zhes// gsol 'debs yar ngos 'bod pa gsan lags na// thugs rjes cig car chu zla'i rtse dga' stsol// rje btsun ngag gi dbang po'i skye ba'i rabs la bstod pa 'di yang mi phyed pa'i slob ma padma dkar po'i dri bsung rin chen spungs pa'i pho brang spros pa'o/// /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// ngag tu brjod pa'i tshig gter khyod kho na'i// dbang du gyur 'dis thub rnams zhir gzims par// mthong ba'i bsil zer gyis btsum lag pad ni// chos kyi rgyal po'i phyogs der mgo lcogs ldem// gsang chen grong gi byid son gser zhes par// mos pa sprin gyi tog de'i 'bad pa'i shugs// gsol 'debs mdzes ma'i lto bar smin gyur pas// lam zab (4na7)sprin bzhon dang dbus mthar dger 'khrungs// srid pa'i 'ching bas dben par zhi ba yi// brtul zhugs la zhen bla ma'i zhabs mthil ni// dmar ba'i nyis sbyangs rigs sad gur kum lus// thos pa'i nags kyi dpal du chags pa'i bzhin// bum pa'i chus dkar mā la ya can ma// gsang ba'i mdzes sdug zla ris rdzogs pa'i phul// bzhi pa'i rgyu skar bdag slong shes rab ri'i// sras bsnyen rgyud mangs can dgar btud tshe des// ma yengs rgyal po'i bu la sems gzhag nas// sgo gsum bcos ma'i bgrod pas rang rigs lha'i// khyim zhugs phan tshun yid la bris dub par// grogs kyi sngags tshig ngal ba'i gsos su bskrun// 'dod dgongs bsam gtan grub pa'i bag ston la// sgyu 'phrul zlos gar rtses pa'i bzhad bgad 'dzum// 'phos pas srid zhi stong gzugs tshon brgya la// ci dgar bsgyur rung dar dkar rdzu la brten// de nas grub pa'i lus dkyil ri'i ltad mor// 'khyam tshe srid par 'khor ba'i lku bskyab ched// las rlung lus kyi gtum mo'i gos dmar rtags// gzung nas 'khor lo bzhi'i rdo bar 'dzegs// dhā tī'i mkha' lding dbang po 'khrul pa'i ri// dum bur 'thor ba'i shugs ldan gyis bsnun kyang*// g.yo med rtsa yi 'dab chags dbang po'i yid// so ma nyis haṃ yig nam mkhar rtag pa dran// ro rkyang yab yum nā ḍi'i rjes 'brang can// bral skyo'i mig chus phyi rol mi gzum pas// bzlog la 'pho ba'i dbugs 'thas phyag bgyis mthar// mun can thab tu sgra tshul 'bar bas bcings// de tshe rigs ldan btsun mo'i bden stobs kyi// rdul des bskul bas snying stobs gangs ri'i sras// bdud rtsis brlan pa'i phyag gis gsos pa'i mod// dbang phyug rin chen bdun yang 'os zhes springs// 'dzag med mtha' bzhi las rgyal khams gsum la// bde stong 'khor lo bsgyur bar dbang bskur der// phung (4ba8)khams 'od gsal du bsad mkha' lding gis// gsol btab bdud rtsis gdan gsum gdengs can slong*// slar yang gnyug ma'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i 'phrul// ston pa'i rigs 'dzin rgyal po'i sras de yang*// rgyal rigs gtsug tor shākya'i rtsa 'dab bzhir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gyur pa'i grags snyan rgyun// dam tshig gtsang ma'i snod gtsang du 'thungs na// myos pa'i spyod pas bsnyengs pa med 'gyur zhes// nges gsang snyan tshig glur sbyor mi la rje'i// rnam thar ston pa'i me long pad dkar lo// lam zab kyi nges gsang sprin gyi bzhon pa'i skyes pa'i rabs su sbyar ba'i tshig rgyan 'di yang rgyal po'i pho brang chen po rin chen spungs su nyams dgar bgyis pa'o/// /rje btsun ngag gi dbang po'i rtogs brjod// tshig ler byas pa dad pa'i nga ro zhes bya ba// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi gong bu dpal 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma mang po la gtugs te gus par phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i zla ba ni// shar ba 'gro ba thams cad kyi// yid mtshor rol ba'i pha mtha' gang*// sus kyang 'tshal min de lta na'ang*// ngag gi brjod pa thams cad las// bla mar bsngags pa bye ba snyed// 'bras bu che bar gsungs mthong bas// dad pa'i dbang gis bstod par bgyi// gangs can dbus na skye dgu yi// bsod nams 'byung gnas ra lung thel// legs byas kun gyis legs byas pas// dga' ldan sa la babs pa 'dra// gang der grub pa kun gyi dpyid// ma smad pa yi rigs gzigs nas// lhums su zhugs tshe mchod sbyin par// nyin byed khong du chud pa rmis// de nas dpal mo gang de nyid// dad pas dkon mchog mchod pa dang*// snying rjes sbyin la dpa' ba ni// thams cad sgrol dang mtshungs pa gyur// bltams tshe rgya mtsho'i gos can ma// yon tan/

dbye ni/ bdag gis 'khur (5na9)bar mi bzod snyam// lhag par skrags pa lan drug 'dar// lha rnams dga' bas me tog char// rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa bab// de'i tshe dbang po'i gzhu rang nyid// 'ongs te phyogs kun sbrel gyur to// gzhon nu nyid nas sngon gyi gnas// dran par gyur pa gzhan pa 'doms// chos 'chad pa dang ting nge 'dzin// bsgom gyis phal pa'i tshul mi spyod// 'phongs pas gzir ba'i 'gro ba la// rang sha ster la gang gus byas pas// 'di dang gzhon nu snying stobs can// mnyam zhes lha dang bcas pa sgrog /gzugs dang lang tshos rgyags pa yi// byin skyes dgra yi dbang po yang*// mtshan dpes brjid pa khyod mthong na// zhum ste zhabs sen gtsug gis mchod// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po las// sdom pa gsum gyi dpal nod nas// rnam pa kun tu mig gi ni// 'bras bu bzhin du gces par bskyangs// mgon des sangs rgyas bstan pa ni// sgrub pa'i sgo nas gzung zhes gtad// ji ltar rdo la bris pa bzhin// khyod kyis khas blangs gzhan mi 'gyur// dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'tshol ba la// nor bzang dang ni chos kyi phyir// srog kyang gtong phod 'phags pa ni// rtag tu du las phul byung mthong*// rje btsun stag lung thad pa sogs// bla ma dam pa bcu bsten nas// rgya dang bod du grags gyur pa'i// mdo rgyud man ngag rdzogs par gsan// gtsug lag slob la skye bo gzhan// lo brgyar ngo shes bgyis pa dang*// khyod kyis yud tsam zhig mnyam pas// 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes kun la grags// paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa la// yi dam lha yis bla ma zhang*// khyod nyid yin zhes lung bstan pas// dang po'i spu long g.yos nas btud// rang nyid mes rlom gser mngal can// chos kyi rgyal po khyod drung du// kha des pa ring du bzhag byas nas// mdun na 'don gyi brtul zhugs 'dzin// gang gi gsung gi cha shas res// gzhan gyi log rtog kun 'joms pas// mgon khyod (5ba10)rtsod pa'i grwar 'khod na/

lha chen lag pa rkyong mi nus// dam pa rnams kyis yang dang yang*// tha snyad sbun pa 'drar gsungs pas// dam pa'i don gda' 'tshol ba'i phyir// yang dag 'jog la brtson par mdzad// de wi ko ṭi ra lung thel// kha rong dben pa'i ri dang gangs// bas mtha'i gnas su rtse gcig par// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag /'khor lo'i mgon po nyid 'grub cing*// dgyes mdzad rdo rjes rjes su bzung*// gsang ba pa sogs dkyil 'khor lha// thams cad yang dang yang du gzigs// dpal ldan nag po chen po yis// ji ltar bsgo ba de sgrub pas// bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad// 'joms pa'i dpa' bo gcig pur gyur// shin tu mi bsrun 'byung po'i tshogs// glags 'tshol byung tshe ting nge 'dzin// gcig gis thams cad myos gyur pas// phyin chad gzhan la gnod pa'ang bzlog /gzhan gyis ring pos bgrod min pa'i// rdo rje 'chang dbang grub pa'i sar// khyod kyi tshe gcig gis byon pas// gom gsum gnon pa skyangs par byas// gyen 'phyur khrod na lhun po dang*// rgyu skar dbus na zla ba ltar// rnal 'byor dbang phyug thams cad kyi// nang na khyod nyid za ma tog /khyod kyi chos sgra dbyar skyes rnga// thos pas skal bzang gtsug phud can// yid dga' bshad sgrub zlos gar gyi// rtsed 'dzes sa 'di mdzes par brgyan// gdung ba can la bdud rtsi dang*// dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung bas na// dpag bsam shing dang 'gro ba'i re// rdzogs byed yid bzhin nor bu'ang khyod// yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug la// dbang 'byor ḍombhi he ru ka /bod 'dir mar pa lo tsa zhes// grags pa khyod las gzhan su zhig /mthu stobs bdag po sangs rgyas dbon// dar ma seng ge khyod dang ni// gnyis pa min par de nyid kyis// gsal bar lung bstan mdzad ces thos// ji ltar khyod la gsol btab pas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// 'bad pa med par 'byung bas na// yi dam lha yang gzhan (6na11)na min// khyod kyi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// mi mthun pa rnams zhi 'gyur bas// chos skyong bsrung ma logs shig tu// bcol ba rang gi nyes par 'khums// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// skyo ba byed skyabs kyi dam pa ni// khyod las gzhan sa rnyed pas// dkon mchog gsum yang khyod kyi mtshan// gangs ri'i khrod na mkhas dang grub// sa skyong blon po 'bangs thams cad// khyod zhabs bkod pa'i rdul phran yang*// gus pas gtsug tu bkur ba bgyid// gang gis sa la rgyal ba'i bstan// gsal bar mdzad pa ci tsam pa// de tsam sngon chad ma byung bas// khyod la dang ba brgyas 'dud do// de ltar bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi// 'gro rnams sgrib pa gnyis bcom nas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te// dpal ldan sangs rgyas thob par shog

/de nyid ma thob bar du bdag /dge ba'i bshes rnams mnyes byed cing*// byang chub spyod pa rgya mtsho la// skyong la med par spyod par shog /chu mo glang lo hor zla dang po'i dus mchod kyi nyin// dge slong padma dkar pos bkra shis mthong smon gyi chos grwar mos gus kyi bdud ba drag pos sbyar ba'o/// /thub pa'i bstod pa dad pas drangs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ston pa zas gtsang sras kyi zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la btud de dus dang rnam pa thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// 'jig rten gsum gyi gtso bo ni// mthu ldan kun kyang skyabs gyur pa'i// ston pa zas gtsang sras de yi// zhabs kyi padmor phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba mi bzad gting nas ni// bdag cag nyon mongs drang slad du// khyod kyis gang zhig ma stsal ba'i// thabs su gyur pa cang med do// khyod ni gnod byed lan du yang*// phan pa lhur len de lta bu// skye bo rang gi pha ma la'ang*// phan pa de ltar lhur mi bgyid// gzhan gyi don gyi slad du khyod// brtson 'grus 'ba' zhig grogs bsten nas// sku srog gtong la dgyes da (6ba12)'dra// gum pa gsos la'ang byung ma gyur// 'di snyed bgyi ba'i mtha' med na// 'di ltar lags zhes ci zhig smos// de 'dra'i khyod drin lan lon pa'i// sgrub de mchis snyam mi bgyid do// rang rig nyams su bstar ba'i mes// sgrib gnyis zhugs shing kun bsregs kyang*// thugs rje'i rlan gyis brlan pa'i thugs// zhi ba'i skam las rgyab phyogs so// gang la nyes pa rnams sad cing*// legs pa'i yon tan kun 'dzom pa// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// khyod 'dra rnyed par ga la 'gyur// khyod sku mtshan dpes mdzes pa'i sku// mig gis 'thungs rnams phyis phyir yang*// dga' ba bskyed par mdzad pas na// bdud rtsi gnyis pa yin par 'khums// khyod mthong bas ni phan thogs mdzad// thos pas rgud pa zhi bar 'gyur// dran pas sdig pa 'phrog byed pas// mthu la thugs pa ma mchis so// blta na sdug pa khyod zhal gyi// nyan na snyan pa'i gsung de dag

/zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya ba las// bdud rtsi 'dzag pa bzhin du gda'// khyod ni dam chos 'od zer gyi// dra bas sems can 'dab brgya'i tshal// sad mdzad nyin mor gyur pas na/ sngon med nyi ma nyid lags so// ji ltar khyod kyi dgongs pa'i dkyel// gting dang pha mtha' med brtags na// rgya mtsho'i zab pa de 'dra ni// gnag rjes lta bur gsal ler gda'// brtan pa'i mdun nas gzhi chung*// dag pa'i gnad ston zla nog /ye shes snang ba'i thad du nyi// me khyer tsam yang mi spyod do// khyod ni gdul bya sna tshogs yid// tshim byed sna tshogs nyams ldan pa'i// sangs rgyas rol mo'i gar mdzad la// nam mkha' ji srid bzhugs zhes grags// srid pa'i 'jigs pas nyen pa'i skyabs// srog chags kun la phan mdzad mgon// don kun sgrub byed mdza' bshes ni// khyod mtshungs gzhan na yod pa min// srid na legs pa gang ci'ang rung*// thams cad bsngos kyang der bas pas// khyod kyi yon tan bla med la// (7na13)dpe lta su yis 'byor par 'gyur// des na 'jig rten dang bstun nas// cung zad bstod par bgyid pa de// smra ba po yi rang ga dang*// thabs dang gcam bu tsam du bas// de lta mod kyang yon tan gyi// slad du bsod nams 'dod nas bdag /spyi brtol skyes nas gang smras pa// khyod la dad pas drangs pa lags// de ltar thub pa khyod bstod pa'i// dge ba'i mthu yis myur bar bdag /'gro gsum dag gis phyag bya'i gnas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /thub pa'i bstod pa dad pas drangs pa zhes bya ba/ dge slong padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /rje btsun tilli pa'i bstod pa ngo mtshar snye ma bzhugs so// rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa'i con pan tilli pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rnal 'byor dbang mo'i sras// bka' ba pas bzhi yi rigs kyi bu// rdo rje 'chang gis byin brlabs pa'i// nga yi yab cig tilli pa// khyod kyi rnam par thar pa ni// cha tsam rna bar lhung bas kyang*// chu gter sgra yis mgrin sngon dang*// yid kyi 'dod pa mtshungs par byas// e ma ho khyod ni sangs rgyas kun// e ma ho byang chub sems dpa' khyod// e ma ho srid zhi thams cad pa'i// bdag nyid khyed la skyabs su mchi// 'jig rten dge ba'i me tog ni// gsar pa'i dpal ster dpag bsam shing*// khyod mthong mig de bsod nams tshogs// ma lus 'dus pa'i gong bu yin// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ji snyed mdun// de snyed sku ni dus gcig tu// ston kyang khyod nyid nyer zhi las// g.yo ba med pa e ma mtshan// thub pa chen po thams cad kyi// chos kyi phung po ji snyed pa// gzigs nas mtha' klas skad du ni// rdzogs par smra ba khyod cig pu// mkhyen pas srid spangs snying rjes ni// zhi la dga' ba ring dor bas// srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pas// khyod nyid srid dang zhi ba'i mgon// de lta'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang*// de nyid 'phags rnams blo yis kyang*// ji tsam (7ba14)brtags kyang mi za las// de la bsam mi khyab ces brjod// mgon khyod rnam pa thams cad par// gzhan gyi don la mi g.yel ba// de bzhin 'gro kun khyed kyi ni// yon tan brjod pas brel bar gyur// khyod zhal mthod dam reg pa dang*// thos sam dran pa'i mod nyid la// nyes pa'i tshogs ni 'thor rlung dang*// lhag par nye ba'i sprin pung bzhin// gang gi grags pa'i gzugs brnyan ni// phyogs kyi me long la bkod pa'i// mdzes pa 'di ni zla 'os kyis// gang ba'i sngo bsangs ma la'ang min// da ni mgon po khyod brtse ba'i phyug

/gnyis 'thung sna ltar legs rkyongs la// srid tsho nyam ngar lhung ba'i 'gro// ma lus 'dren par mdzad du gsol// dbang phyug khyod kyi chos sprin las// legs bshad char yang da phob la// lus dang yid kyi gdung ba kun// ma lus zhi bar mdzad du gsol// e ma ho da ni mgon khyod dang*// rang gi sems nyid dbye med pa'i// des gsang bla na med pa'i dbyings// kun gyis myur du mthong gyur cig /dge slong padma dkar pos gnyal yangs pa can gyi dbus// rdo rje gdan dang nye ba'i tshal du'o// mgon de mthong ba'i nyi gzhon lag pa yis// btang bar gyur kyang thos pa zla ba'i bu// 'tshu dkar can gyis rol pa'i ku mu ta// mdzes pa 'di yis bstod tshig dri bsung bkyi/// /rje btsun nā ro pa la dka' ba bcu gnyis kyi mdzad pa'i sgo nas bstod pa bzhugs so// dpal rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po de nyid la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya chen yon tan dang ldan pas// rgyal ba gnyis par rab grags pa// sa gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu// nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// snying rjes bran pa khyod kyi thugs// gnam lcags bye ba mgor lhung kyang*// gzhan gyi don las ldog pa'i skabs// cung zad tsam yang yod ri skan// de slad khyod tshul gzhan dag gis// bsam yang nus pa ma lags so// khyod ni pha rol gzhung lugs kun// khong du chud kyang ma ngoms par// tshu rol bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// gtsug lag yongs kyi pha mthar (8na15)byon// brtse ba'i shugs ni ma khegs pas// khyod kyis dam chos kho na'i ched// lhun po brtsegs pa bzhin ma thob// gtsug lag khang gi ba gam nas// 'khor ba'i gcong rod ltar 'jigs pa'i// g.yang sa ngag tu mchod par mdzad// shā ri'i bu yi shes rab ltar// rno ba 'od ma'i shing tshal gyis// rang lus phug kyang gzhan phan la// chags khyod ldeg cing g.yos ma gyur// rgod ma kha ltar 'bar ba'i nang*// padma can la ngang pa bzhin// zhugs tshe lus ni bud shing ltar// tshig kyang dgyes pa'i bzhin ras gsal// na chung bzhin du mi gtsang ba// grong khyer skye bo'i phyi sa'i 'dam// padma'i phyag gis rab blangs nas// tsham tshom med pa nyid du zos// 'gro rnams gnod pa chung dus kyang*// tsher ma lta bur rno bar 'gyur// khyod ni skye bos 'dam bu bzhin// bcom la'ang dbang po thul ba lags// khrag rgyun thun mtshams gos dmar gyis// bzhin ras zla ba bkab gyur kyang*// snying stobs 'dzum pa'i 'od dkar ni// srid pa gsum gyi bar du bkye// mtha' klas sems can rnams sgrol ba'i// bya ba'i khur chen 'dzin bzod khyod// mgo dang yan lag gcod byed la// lhag tu snying rje'i spu long g.yos// 'khri shing gzhon nu dang mtshungs pa'i// gzhon nu ma yi mchog gzung bas// thog dang 'dra ba'i ngan smras ni// bye ba snyed kyang bzod par byas// bsdus 'joms gnas kyi bzod dka' las// brgya 'gyur lta bu'i gdung bar yang*// padma'i mtsho la dri zhim gyis// bos pa'i dad pa bzhin du zhugs// mthon mthing 'khyel ba'i mi gzur gyis// skye 'gro'i sems dang mig lhan cig

/'ching ba sgeg mo'i dam pa yang*// the tshom med pa bla mar byin// lus kun khyab pa'i srin bu rnams// rang gi khrag gis tshim mdzad pas// srog la gus pa lhod pa bzhin// 'phongs pa rnams la min par 'khums// shin tu zab pa'i chos thos na// shi yang gson pa yin no// (8ba16)zhes/ lus gang khrag gis chag chag dang*// dbang po bcad nas me tog bgyis// de tsho sman gyi// mdangs can mchi ma'i char 'bebs shing*// sa ni 'jigs shing sgrag pa yi// bco brgyad bar du 'dar bar gyur// ji ltar mkha' la bsil zer can// gnyis pa bzhin du sa 'dir yang*// chos phyir gtong ba'i spyod tshul la// khyod dang mtshungs pa su zhig yod// gang gi yon tan 'od dkar ni// gsal zhing dri ma med pa yis// mkhas dang grub pa'i nyi ma gzhan// smag rum mun pa nyid du byas// 'gro kun zhing gi rdul snyed du// gyur pa re re'i lce yang ni// de snyed gyur pas ji srid du// brjod kyang khyod tshul 'dzad pa min// de bas rnam pa thams cad du// khyod la skyabs su mchi lags kyis// 'di nas skye ba ma lus par// thugs rje'i phyag gis 'dren du gsol// dge slong padma dkar pos yang rtse'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o/// /yang de la bstod pa/ rje btsun nā ro pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya chen chos rnams gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa// kun la lhag par brtse bas srid pa nyid// ji srid 'gro la phan pa mi 'dor ba'i// dpal ldan nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs byis pa'i dus nyid nas// bram ze'i las drug rtog ge'i bstan bcos rnams// khong du chud pas smra ba thams cad kyis// chos bzhin brgal bar mi nus de la 'dud// rig gnas gzhung lugs rol mtsho'i pha mthar son// sde snod chos kyi bang rim mthon por 'dzegs// rgyud sde lhun po'i rtse mor ngal bso ba'i// zla med mkhas pa'i tog der dad pas 'dud// srid pa'i gdung ba bas kyang ches drag pa'i// bcu gnyis dka' ba'i mtha' mar te lo pa'i// yon tan ma lus 'phos pa 'drar thob pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// dbus 'gyur gtsug lag khang chen bi kra mar// mu stegs rgol ba bzlog pa'i sgo skyong du// (9na17)mda' gsol de tshe mkhas pa thams cad kyi// dogs pa'i ri bo bsnyil bar mdzad der 'dud// mkhas pa'i dbus na theg gsum chos kyi sgo// thogs pa med par ji bzhin bstan mdzad pas// thub dbang khyod nyid khyod las gzhan zhig tu// rdo rje 'chang chen med ces grags la 'dud// lung rigs gad rgyangs chen po re res kyang*// phas rgol khengs ldan gnyis 'thung yongs kyi snying*// cig car lkog mar 'byin pas 'jig rten na// smra ba'i seng ge gcig pur gyur la 'dud// tshig don blta bas mi ngoms lang tsho can// khyod gzhung mdzes mas mkhas pa kun gyi yid// phrogs nas gzhung gzhan nyag mo'i sgeg 'chos su// mthong nas ring du 'dor bas khyod la 'dud// sum cu rtsa bdun nyer bzhi'i gnas kun tu// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi dpon mdzad cing*// skal ba bzang po pa rnams smin mdzad pa'i// grub pa'i khyu mchog dzñā na siddhir 'dud// brtan g.yo thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lor gzigs// bgrang yas yi dam lha dang dbyer med du// song bas dkyil 'khor spro dang bsdu ba la// dbang 'byor mgon der spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar cha tsham bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// deng nas 'khor bam zad de srid du// sems can kun gyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang*// lam ston dge ba'i bshes su bdag gyur cig

/bdag kyang skye ba kun tu khyod nyid la// brten nas spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam pa'i dpal// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar ji lta ba// de ltar spyod pas sangs rgyas sar bgrod shog /'di yang*/ dge slong padma dkar pos bkra shis mthong smon gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'o/// /rje btsun mi la'i rtogs brjod utpa la'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so// rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// yon tan rin chen thams cad kyi// (9ba18)'byung gnas rin chen 'byung gnas bzhin// dpal ldan 'jig rten kun gyi mchog /mi la ras pa'i zhabs la 'dud// chu gter las ni zla ba dang*// dge ba'i dpal las khyod 'khrungs gtam// thos pas srid dang zhi ba pa'i// yid la dga' ston ci yang bkye// bzod kun chags byams pas thugs// dkris shing snying rjer dga' ba dang*// rab grags la yang dbang thul khyod// skye dgu'i gnyen bshes mchog yin yang*// mchod 'os brjod la dgag pa'i tshig /rtsub mo kha nas rgyu ba rnams// gson po'i srog song nyid dgongs nas// ma yi ngag las 'gong mi mdzad// brgya byin ya la da ma bgos shing*// lha gzhon dmag tshogs ma lhags par// skabs gsum dgra bo'i dpung 'di dag /khyod kyi nus mthus cig car bcom// bzhin dmar smar smin 'khyog ser// lta byed glog 'gyu lta bu can// dus min dus dang mtshungs pa yi// khro bo khyod la su zhig 'tshe// de tshe srid gsum zol kho nar// mthong bas skyo ldan dge ba'i bshes// kun tu 'tshol bskom pa yis// gdungs pa rnams kyis chu rgyun bzhin/ ji ltar rgya mtsho nor bu'i gter// yin zhes ring na rna ba yi// bdud rtsis dga' ba'i don mthun khyod// 'ongs der btung ba'ang gzhan las so// de na sgra bsgyur mar pa'i mtshan// rnyed pas khyod la dgyes pa ni// bdud rtsi rab sbyin zhugs pa yi// chu gter yang dag rgyas pa bzhin// skabs der bdud tshogs ma lus pa'i// snying la khyod kyi sgro ldan ni// rnon po ma 'phangs na yang de// yid 'khrugs nyid kyis nyams par byas// gang tshe rdo rje rin po che// rgyal mtshan rtse la bkod gyur nas// 'dzam gling 'phongs pa bsal ba yi// mtshan mo 'jig rten mig la byung*// bla ma'i bka' bzhin rang gi srog

/dor nas gzhan don gdung ba la// bur shing las kyang mnyen pa dang*// rdo rje bas kyang sra ba thob// lhun po brtson 'grus ri bo yi// (10na19)do zla min bsam ring du song*// mkha' 'di snying stobs mi shong zhes// pha mtha' med pa nyid du bros// 'di mthong skrag ste 'chi med bu// thams cad chu 'dzin las 'thon nas// me tog gsil ma'i char 'bebs pa// phyogs kun bskor bar 'dod pa snyam// dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs tshe khyod// bzhad pa rdo rjer brjod pa po// dpa' bo dang ni mkha' 'gro ma// lhags pa dus mtha'i sprin phung bzhin// khyod gtam thos pas nā ro pa// 'di tshul dri med dang mtshungs par// ma byas byed po rmongs pa ste// dpe yis kyang ni dbul lo gsung*// skyes bu khyod kyis bla ma dang*// bla ma des kyang khyod brgyan pa// dam pa rnams kyis yon tan dang*// yon tan gyis kyang dam pa bzhin// drang srong ri byi'i khyor chu yi// hub tu rgya mtsho chen po dang*// khyod kyi thugs su chos kyi tshul// grangs med pa yang song bar gyur// grub pa zla ba'i rtse dga' la// mngon phyogs ku mu ta khyod la ni// phrag dog mi dge'i padmo ni// gzi brjid nyams shing zum par snang*// las kyi rba rlabs rgod pa can// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem pa'i phyir// dka' thub shin tu bzod dka'i me// gdung ba che la khyod kyis brten// ma bcom na yang khyod bcom bzhin// brtas par gyur kyang lhung ba bzhin// 'tsho ba ldan yang 'tsho med bzhin// rgyu yang g.yo bar mi nus bzhin// mtho ris na ni yongs 'du'i shing*// mi yi gnas na 'od stong can// sa 'og gdengs kar nor bu ste// dben par mdzes pa khyod nyid do// lha mo bzhin gyi chu skyes kyis// padma can yang dman byed rnams// lan brgyar bdag gi dpal mdzad ces// brjod la khyod thugs mi g.yo gang*// yid srubs me tog mda' lnga yis// 'jig rten kun las rgyal ba de// rnam 'gyur drag po'i dpung bcas pa// khyod kyis 'bad pa med par bcom// sum cu gnyis kyi grong bshig ste// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung*// dbu mar bsad nas mi 'gyur ba'i// bde ba'i pha mthar byon pa (10ba20)ci// khyod ni rdo rje 'chang dbang du// sangs rgyas de tshe bod kyi yul// 'di nyid 'og min gnas mchog tu// nges nas zhing gzhan 'tshol pa dor// chos kun rang dar mnyam pa nyid// gcig tu gzigs kyang ya mtshan gyi// snang ba ji snyed gzhan dag gi// mig la khyod kyis bsgrub par mdzad// cha shas rdzogs pas bdud rtsi'i 'od// mun nang gsal ba padmo'i gnyen// gnyis skyes za bas sgra gcan khyod// sbyangs pas mdzes pa gser ri'ang yin// lho yi rlung gis mi bzlog cing*// tsan dan ljon pas mi bzod pa// lus can yid kyi gdung ba 'di// khyod gsung bsil bas 'joms par byas// khyod dang khyod sras ras gos kyis// nyin mo zla 'od ldan byas pa'i// grags pa'i me tog chun po des// phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna ba brgyan// rgya mtsho dga' ba gza' skar rnams// khyod la dang bas bskor mthong nas// 'gran 'dod dbyig gi khu ba ni// sngon la snyegs pa nyid kyis brel// khyod kyi grags pa'i gang gā ni// 'jig rten 'di na rgyu mthong nas// chu rnams ngal ba med par yang*// de yi rjes su snyegs pa snyam// bsod nams kyis mtho ri bo ni// brgya las lce ba khyod mthong ste// sa ni 'jig rten byed po des// shin tu mkhregs par bzos pa bzhin// sa hā ka ra'i dri bzang ni// sol ba la yang bslu ba min// khyod kyi thugs rje'i gter chen po// gnod par byed la'ang rjes su 'jug

/khyod ni rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung*// thogs med par ston no zhes// kun la bsgo phyir rlung 'di yang*// phyogs bcur rgyug pa nyid du nges// khyod kyis lus 'di ma spangs par// mkha' spyod chen por byon mthong bas// me ni steng du bgrod pa bzhin// mchog tu go de gyen du 'bar// mdor na dbyangs can lha mo yis// nam mkha' ma zad par brjod kyang*// khyod kyi yon tan mi 'dzad pas// bdag ni spyi brtol smra bar zad// gang der dad pa'i rlung gzhon gyis// bskul bas bdag yid 'khri shing ni// g.yo ba bstod tshig me tog dag /(11na21)'thor 'dis khyod thugs dgyes gyur cig /ces pa 'di sang dge slong snyan dngags mkhan padma dkar pos bkra shis mthong smon du sbyar ba'o/// /rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i bstod pa rgyad 'bod ma bzhugs so// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bzhad pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ji snyed// khyod dang rnam par dbye ba ma mchis pas// gtan gyi skyabs gnas mdzod cig mi la rje// mthong dang reg pas lus can sdug bsngal las// grol bar gyur mod de la ngo mtshar ci// thos pas thar pa'i dga' ston la sbyor ba'i// ya mtshan yid la dran no mi la rje/ rig sngags grub pa'i ri bo'i rtser son zhing*// nag po'i phyogs kyi mthar byed gcig pu pa// mthu chen nyin mo'i dbang phyug khyod lags kyi// rtag par 'jig rten skyongs shig mi la rje// rdo rje lta bur sra ba'i snying stobs kyis// sgrib gnyis dpung las rgyal ba'i mtshan mnga' bas// rje btsun nā ro pas kyang phyag mdzad ces// dad pa'i 'o dod 'bod mi la rje// sgra bsgyur mar pas sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang bzhi bskur tshe mngon sum yi dam lhas// bzhad pa rdo rjer gsol ba khyod nyid la// 'di phyi'i re ba ltos bcas so mi la rje// oṃ yig glur len ril bas lag brel ba'i// dka' thub nor can tshangs pa'i drang srong gi// khengs pa 'phrog pa khyod kyi rnam thar la// bags kyis slob par 'dod do mi la rje// lha dang gnod sbyin bu mo'i phyag rgya dang*// lhan cig brtul zhugs spyod pas sa gsum gyi// gnas dang zhing rnams kun tu dgyes rol ba'i// grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa mi la rje// ddhu ti'i mkha' la rgyu ba'i sgra gcan gyis// g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i bgrod pa kun bcom nas// bcu drug dga' ba'i pha mthar rnam rtsan pa'i// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i khyab bdag mi la rje// khyod kyi yon tan re res nam mkha'i khongs// gang bar byas pas gzhan gyi phun tshogs (11ba22)rnams// 'pho ba'i go skabs bkag 'dis khyod las gzhan// bdag la mgon skyabs med do mi la rje// 'di dang phyogs bcu'i zhing du skrad cig der// bsam yas rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i zlos gar mkhan// ras dkar na bza' can gyi zung 'jug sku/

yang yang blta bar 'dod do mi la rje// phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i rna shal ma lus pa// grags pa'i gur kum dog pas brel bgyis mod// rdo rje'i glu yis bdag gi rna ba'ang*// skal bzang mdzad par 'os so mi la rje// mtha' dang bral zhing dbus su mi gnas kyang*// chos rnams kun ro mnyam nyid gyur pa'i// khyod kyi thugs kyi gsang ba gang lags par// bdag kyang 'jug par 'tshal lo mi la rje// srid pa'i btson ra 'jigs rung 'dir lhung ba'i// nyam thag 'gro rnams bskyur nas rje btsun khyod// mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs par phod pa zhes// bdung ba'i smre sngags thal lo mi la rje// rje btsun mi la'i zhabs la bstod pa rgyang nas 'bod pa'i tshul 'di/ rje nyid kyi slob brgyud kyi tha shal padma dkar pos dol bkra shis gshongs kyi sgar du dad pa'i shugs kyis byang rgyal du sbyar ba'o/// /rje btsun ras chung ba'i bstod pa snying rje'i nga rom zhes bya ba bzhugs// rje btsun ras chung pa'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan ras pa'i thugs sras rgyu skar gyi// khongs na khyod nyid kho na bsil zer can// lam stong ral pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa// dbugs 'byin mdzod cig rje btsun ras chung pa// 'phags yul chos kyi chu gter lan gsum du/ brgal ba'i ded dpon khrod na snyan rgyud kyi// yid bzhin nor bu mchis pa khyod nyid de// bod yul 'phongs pa sol cig ras chung pa// bstar ni mkhas shing khas pa brgya phrag gis// gtsug gi nor bur bzung ba khyod yin pas// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad kyi// mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod cig ras chung pa// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol son gyur cing*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub tshul bzhin du// brnyes pa kun gyi rje (12na23)yang khyed lags pas// 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyobs shig ras chung pa// chu bur brtsegs 'dra'i lus nyid rgyal ba'i skur// grub nas skye 'chi med pa skal bzang gi// don mdzad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi gtso bo khyod// bdag gi bla ma mdzod cig ras chung pa// las kyi me lce 'bar ba stong phrag gis// bsreg cing khro chus 'tshod dang lcags kyi ris// thal bar 'thag sogs dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal kun// med par mdzod cig rje btsun ras chung pa// shin tu lus che kha skam mi gzhan zhing*// bkres pas nyen te cho de mi bzad pa'i// gshin rje'i 'jig rten nyam ngas gtams pa rnams// skyob par 'tshal lo rje btsun ras chung pa// gcig la gcig 'tsheg gnod pa kho na'i rten// glen cing rmongs pas thar pa'i dus med pa// dud 'gro'i skye bar lhung ba'i 'gro ba rnams// thugs rjes drongs shig rje btsun ras chung pa// gzhan gyi dpal la sdang bas gzir ba'i sems// lhag par rtsub pa shal ma li 'dra zhing*// kun tu rtsod pas mnar ba'i lha ma yin// byams pas gang mdzod rje btsun ras chung pa// rtswa mtshungs 'byor la bag med yan gyur pas// dge ba ma bgyis 'chi dus ngan 'gro'i sar// lhung bar mthong nas sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa'i// lha rnams skyongs shig rje btsun ras chung pa// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi 'bab cing*// sdug bsngal mang po'i chu srin gyis gtams pa// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa las// bdag cag sgrol cig rje btsun ras chung pa// 'dus byas mi rtag myur du 'jig nges la// rtag tu re ba'i phyi tshig bsgrub bsgrub nas// chos la phyi bshol byed pa skye bo'i blo// chos bsgyur zhig rje btsun ras chung pa// shin tu rnyed dka' dal 'byor tshang pa'i lus// 'byor pa'i dus su phan bde mi bsgrub par// don chung bya ba zhig gis brel ba tsho// thugs rjes gzigs shig rje btsun ras chung pa// thar pa'i lam du 'jug pa'i nyam chung rnams// rkyen ngan dbang du mi 'chor bar// don chen myur du 'grub pa'i mthu nus kyang*// khyed la ro'i rje btsun ras chung pa// (12ba24)de ltar rje btsun ras chung pa'i bstod pa snying rje'i nga rom 'di yang*// dge slong padma dkar pos bkra shis mthong smon gyi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o/// /bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i rnam par thar pa'i gsol 'debs// dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi seng ge'i nga rol byang bas// smra ba'i 'dun sar mkhas dbang ri dgas ni// mtha' dag snying rnams 'dar byed spobs pa'i shugs// phyogs las rnam rgyal mnga' bder phyag 'tshal// rgyud sde rgya mtsho las 'ongs kun dga' ba'i// legs bshad bdud rtsi'i snying po rnam dpyod pa// bum par bzung nas ris med gdul bya yi// nang gi gdung bsal ba der phyag 'tshal// bya 'dul nyin mo'i zer brgya dmar 'od kyis// tshul khrims gangs ri bzhu ba'i chu klung rnams// ngoms par 'thungs pas zhi dul nges pa yi// chu gter dar bar mdzad pa der phyag 'tshal// shar phyogs shānti'i rir 'dzegs zla ba'i 'od// gzhon nus mchog gi dngos grub ku ma ta// phye ba'i yon tan dri bzang ci yar gis// phyogs rnams skal bzang byas pa der phyag 'tshal// bstan 'dzin rme bya gzhon nu'i dpal yon du/

mthu stob 'bigs byed dga' ma'i lto ba nas// man ngag dbyar skyes rnga bo cher brdung ba'i// grags pa'i char 'bebs mkhan po der phyag 'tshal// kun bgreng nags su skal ldan gnyis 'thung khyu/ bshad sgrub rgyu rtsal gnas la mkhas byas nas// thub bstan gyen du 'degs pa'i stobs kyis ni// bdu sde'i g.yul ngo bcom pa der phyag 'tshal// rdo rje btsun mos nyer mchod rgyal po khyod// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon dang dbyer med du// nges nas da lta'ang thar 'dod gus pa'i mig /g.yo med blta sar gyur pa der phyag 'tshal// chen po'i zur phud dang 'grogs nor bu'i tshogs// ma lus gang gi zhabs stegs nyid gyur pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan phag gru pa'i// ring lugs 'jig rten gsum na dar gyur cig /ces pa 'di yid padma dkar pos// de wi ko ṭa rang byung gi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'o/// /(13na25)rje btsun gling ras pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs bzhugs// rje btsun gling ras padma rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// lnga brgya pa yi gtsug rgyan du// gsal bar lung bstan rnal 'byor pa// gling chen ram pa'i zhabs la 'dud// padmā ka ra ji lta ba// de lta ba yi nus mthu la// dbang bsgyur khyod kyis gdug pa can// ma lus 'joms par mdzad la 'dud// dpag yas gdams pa'i gter mnga' zhing*// drod rtags kun la ci dga' bar// spyod pas kun la mi 'jigs pa'i// spobs pa'i dam pa brnyes la 'dud// kun tu bzang po'i nags nang na// dag dang ma dag snang ba kun// bla mar mthong ba'i mos gus kyis// mchog gi dngos grub thob la 'dud// chu bo gang gā'i pha rol na// sa ra ha dang tshu rol na// rtogs pa mtho ba'i grags snyan gyis// sa gsum khyab par gyur la 'dud// ye shes mkha' 'gros glegs bam zhig /gtad pa khong du bzhes rmis nas// rgyal ba'i gsung la rgyal ba bzhin// thogs pa med par mkhyen la 'dud// lha dang mi mo dang 'grogs kyang*// 'dzag pa'i dri tsam mi mnga' bas// tshangs par spyod pa thams cad kyi// mchog tu gyur pa khyod la 'dud// 'od zer chen pos dbang bskur ba// thob la sangs rgyas rnams kyi bzhin// rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal tshab tu// mkha' 'gros con pan bcings der 'dud// khyod gsung dad pa'i bu mo ni// tshig don dkar ba'i gshog brkyang nas// snyan dngags glu dbyangs len bzhin du// skye dbu'i snying mtshor rol la 'dud// mkhas pa'i 'bun sar phal rgol rnams// chos bzhin pham byas nam mkha' la// 'phags par gyur tshe thub dbang nyid// byon nas snyems pa bzlog der 'dud// khyod kyis rgyal ba'i gzhung bkrol ba// de la mkhas shing mkhas rnams kyis// dpyad pa gsum gyis legs pa rtags kyang*// skyon mi mnga' bas bstod der 'dud// phul du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// lus can yid mgur byas pa'i mthus// dang bas zhabs sen 'od dkar can// gtsug gis mchod par byas la 'dud// (13ba26)ji ltar khyod kyis phye'i lam// yangs par mi 'gro de dag rnams// g.yang sar mchod pa nyid mthong bas// bdag ni khyod la 'dud par byed// khyod kyi rnam par thar pa la// mtha' mi mnga' mod cung zad tsam// brjod la rtog ge pa rnams kyang*// gtan tshigs bzang po mthong bas bstod// de ltar rje btsun gling gi bstod pa 'di yang*// dge slong padma dkar pos chos grwa bkra shis mthong smon du sbyar ba'o/// /'brug bstod tshigs bcad go bder sbyar na// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse ma lus pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid 'phags spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ye shes rdo rje zhes se gsum na snyan par grags pa gang gi zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la/

yan lag mchog gis btugs te dus dang rnam pa thams cad par gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// phun tshogs dge legs bye bas rab bskrun zhing*// rgya chen yon tan phung po'i gter gyur pa'i// 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mi bzad bdud kyi dgra thabs bzlog dka' ba// snying stobs mtshon cha rnon pos legs 'joms pa'i// phan bde'i dpung chen dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// nyi 'od lan brgyar 'thungs pa'i padmo bzhin// yon tan bdud rtsi'i tshogs kun rab rgyas pas// nyon mongs gdung sel dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhi sku bsam gyis mi khyab gsal gnas las// gzugs sku'i 'od kyis 'gro blo'i mun sel ba'i// bstan pa'i gnyen gcig dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkhyen rab zugs rje'i cha shas yongs rdzogs pas// da byung nus pa'i 'od dkar 'bum phrag can// rgyu skar dbang po dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// stobs bcu'i lus grims mi 'jigs mche ba bzhi// ma 'dres chos kyi ral par mdzes pa'i// smra ba'i (14na27)seng ge dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// tshogs gnyis rtsa ba rab brtan par phyin bcu'i// yal ga'i khyon yangs sku gsum 'bras phyug pa'i/ dpag bsam dbang po dpal ldan 'brug pa la/ gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gdong bzhi nye dbang mig stong dregs pa'i tshogs// grags pa 'chi med nga yis zil mnan pa'i// snyan pas kun khyab dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// cig car mngon mtho nges legs dpal yon gyi/ spyod yul gnas pa'i bsam pa rdzogs byed pas/

'phongs pa kun sel dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// chos phung bya ba'i chu klung mngon 'bab cing*// theg gsum naur bu'i tshogs kyi yongs gtams pa'i// rin chen 'byung gnas dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// legs bshad zir gyis 'jig rten yongs 'gengs pas// zla nyi skyengs te skabs gsum lam 'bros pa'i// lus can mig mchog dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi char chen pos// 'gro la dge ba'i lo tog smin byed pa'i// thugs rje'i chu 'dzin dpal ldan 'brug pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// khyod la bstod pa'i dge ba gang thob pas// 'gro 'dis yon tan mtha' yas mgon po rnams// mthong nas chos spyan dri med rab skyes te// byang chub dam pa myur du thob par shog /mgon po khyod kyi gsung rang rtag nyan zhing*// dad brtse brtson pas byang chub lam thams cad// rdzogs dang rgyal ba'i zhing kun spyod byed cing*// sems can thams cad smin mdzad nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di nyid cog pu pa g.ya' bzangs pas bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong mi pham padma dkar pos shar kong po'i sa'i cha rdo gzhong dang nye ba'i sgar du sbyar ba'o/// /gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rnam thar (14ba28)gsol 'debs ngo mtshar gyi snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug thams cad kyi con pan gcig pu lta dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi skyabs gnas chos kyi rje chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras pa// mtshan dngos ye shes rdo rje zhes grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhag par gsal bde'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug thams cad kyi// con pan gcig pur gyur pa chos kyi rgyal// mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde'i byed pa po// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bod yul gtsang gi yul gru rgya grong zhes// sa la sum rtsen dga' ba'i tshal bkod par// sā la chen po lta bu'i gyad kyi rigs// rnam bzhi'i gzigs pas bzung bar mdzad pa khyod// phyogs bcu bu mo'i 'gram par ya mtshan ni// gsar pa'i smug rtsi byug la byed po yis// rnam par sprul bzhin yum la bltams ma thag

/la ba'i na bza' can yang ma mar gyur// khyod ni bden par zhen pa'i ri bo kun// bsnyil bar goms pas byis pa'i dus nyid nas// sra mkhregs rdo ba'i ngos la 'jim par bzhin// zhabs zung ri mo mtha' dag gsal bar bkod// rgya chen chos kun gzigs pa'i spyan ldan khyod// 'gro 'dir rig gnas slob pa'i tshul ston pa// 'di ni mi mchog zas gtsang sras po yi// spyod pa'i mtha' dang rnam par dbye ba ci// kun dga' bskyed pa'i legs bshad 'od stong gis// mkhas kun yid mkha' nyin mor mdzad nas khyod// gangs can ri bo'i mda' bsnun dbang po yi// sras kyi thu bor gyur la gsol ba 'debs// de nas di wi ko ṭir lo gsum du// spong ba'i brtul zhugs nyid kyis 'da' ba na// me tog gzhu can dpung las rnam rgyal ba'i// rgyal mtshan bsgrengs nas grub pa'i sa la byon// 'thung spyod grong du 'khor lo sdom pa yis// lung bstan de bzhin rdo rje btsun mos kyang*// dbugs 'byin brnyes khyod zhing 'di'i mkha' 'gro dang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo phye bas bla mar bzung*// de'i tshe (15na29)skyil krung gcig gis zla ba gsum// yang dag 'jog la snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe// rnam gzigs la sogs sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun// mngon sum byon nas zab mo'i gdams pa stsal// dbus 'gyur tshal du mu stegs gnyis 'thungs dgra// smra ba'i seng ge nā ro par gyur pa'i// gtam dang lhan cig bstan pas sa chen po// khyab pa'i lung bstan bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dgongs nas ji bzhin du// 'chad cing sgrub dang sgrub la sbyor ba yang*// khyod nyid kho nar rig nas gangs can gyi// skye bo ma lus khyod zhabs snyeg pas bre la// gdul bya kun la rang rang skal ba dang*// 'tsham par 'jug pa'i chos tshul ji snyed pa// ston par mdzad 'dis khyod dang thub pa'i dbang*// tha dad 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ring du bros// gzhan yang dbang rnon tshe 'dis sangs rgyas su// nges par mdzad cing rdo rje'i tshig thams cad// ji bzhin 'byed pas rdo rje 'chang yang khyod// 'og min gnas kyang 'di bas gzhan du ci// dbang phyug khyod kyi rjes bzung 'jig rten gsum// bka' rgyud gsung gi me tog thod bcings dang*// yon tan do shal mdzes pa'i grub rigs kyis// gang bar byas 'di 'chi med grong khyer bzhin// mthong thos dran gyur dad dang dang ba yis// nyes pa kun las grol la ya mtshan ci// khyod skus reg pa'i rdul phran re res kyang*// srid pa'i 'jigs pa skyo ba 'di lhag par mtshar// khyod ni nyer zhi'i dbyings su gshegs gyur kyang*// mtha' yas 'gro la chags pa ma bzlog pas// slar yang sprul pa'i snang brnyan ji snyed kyis// 'gro ba'i don kun mdzad der gsol ba 'debs// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad kyi/

'di nas gzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// yang dag lam gyis mkhan dge ba'i bshes// khyod las gzhan du med do thugs rjes gzigs// bdag kyang skye ba kun tu dam pa'i chos// ma lus 'dzin pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyis// yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol legs son te// bla ma'i bla ma nyid du gyur cig gu// 'di ni dge slong padma dkar pos// thub pa'i (15ba30)dbang phyug mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen lo ro mog pa'i ri// lha rtse'i theg chen pho brang du sbyar ba'o/// /bla ma'i maṇḍal/ nam mkha' dbyings rnams kun nas gang ba'i spos kyi chu gter 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung rin chen padmo rin chen 'od 'byin rgyas pas khyab pa'i snying por nor bu'i khor yug gi// nang na zhing khams rgya mtshos gzhi rin chen las grub rim gyis gzhol ba bkod legs ma lus bkod pa'i phul gyis 'jig rten khams re'ang 'dod yon rmad byung 'phyur ba gang*/ mtha' yas sangs rgyas zhing gis bskor zhing kun bzang mchod sprin ma tshang ba'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i rdul der rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa thams cad snang ba can/ gcig tu 'du zhing so sor ma 'dres byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin de dag bdag gi dge ba'i sems kyis sprul te dpal ldan bla mar dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ yang na/ zhing khams rgya mtshor rdul rer rdul snyed kyi/ sangs rgyas zhing dang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// kun gyis brgyan ldan ji snyed 'od 'phro'i rtser// rgyal ba sras bcas rnam thar kun snang zhing*// 'khor zhi'i 'dod dgu ma tshang med 'dus pa// chos dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'phul// nam mkha'i khams khyab srid pa'i mthar gnas nas// chos kyi rgyal mo mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /'brug bstod lhug pa// rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen po/

sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi bkod pa'i gnas la gnas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i yul la 'jug pa'i rnam par thar pa can/ kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ma lus pa'i bdag po chen po// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas 'jig rten gyi sgron ma dam par gyur pa/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i rgyal thabs kyi con pan can// kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig /rgyal ba shākya'i bstan pa 'dzin (16na31)pa la ston pa gnyis par gyur pa/ 'phags pa thams cad dgyes pa'i tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa/ ye shes chen po'i stobs kyis phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba can/ kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig /brtul zhugs grub pa thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten/ thams cad kyi skyabs mgon dad dpung gnyen/ gdul bya bya ba smin grol gyi gnas la 'god pa'i rdzu 'phrul mtshungs pa med pa can// kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig /yid can thams cad kyi bsam pa'i re bskong ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ 'dul ba'i rkyen bzhin du 'jug pa'i dpag bsam gyi ljon pa'i shing gdod ma'i sems kyi ngo bo nyid rjen par ston pa'i shing rta chen po can/ kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig /bdag cag khyed kyis rjes su gzung ba'i bu slob thams cad kyis// chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid kyi bzod pa thob nas/ rdzogs smin sbyang gsum mthar phyin pa'i gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyis/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa deng nyid du thob par gyur cig

/rin chen spungs pa'i chos skyong ba'i rgyal bu chen po kun dga' dbang phyug don yod grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal 'dod du padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /rje mthu stobs zhabs la bstod pa/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po dang gnyis su mi phyed pa'i bla ma dam pa yon tan ye shes dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod 'os cher rlom ral pa'i ri bo la/ zhabs sen zla ba bkod nas thar 'dod kyi// lam stor ngal ba yongs la srog rtsol ba// yon tan ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sum rtse na mā li'i 'breng bas mi mtshon zhing*// mā la ya ra skyes rlung gi khengs 'phrogs pa/ chos kyi bdud rtsis snying gi (16ba32)gdung sel mkhan// yon tan ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sri zhi min pa srid zhi'i rang bzhin can// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rol dgyes spyod pas// rgyal ba kun dang gnyis su mi phyed pa'i// yon tan ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dad cing dang ba'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na// dgos 'dod re ba thams cad legs skong ba'i// yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog gyur bla ma rje// yon tan ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zag med yon tan phung po thams cad dang*// gnyis pa min yang 'khor zhi'i rnam pa ni// cir yang ston pa'i thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// yon tan ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gang zhig spros pa'i mtshan ma kun bral yang*// rtag tu kun gsal phyogs kyi gdong pa la// ngo mtshar ri mo ci yang 'god mdzad pa// yon tan ye shes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag cag ma rig mun pa'i khrod 'khyams pas// yang dag dge ba'i lam gyis 'phongs pa kun// thugs rjes gzigs shig dge legs snang ba brgyas// thar pa'i lam der myur bar 'khrid du gsol// rje btsun de nyid kyi slob ma mi phyed pa'i dad pa can padma dkar pos rje nyid kyi gdan sa rdo rje gling tsan dan ljon pa'i nags gseb tu sbyar ba'o/// /rje sgyu ma'i gar mkhan gyi rnam thar gsol 'debs// na ma shrī mā sna ṅgu rū pā dā ya/

mtshungs pa med pa'i chos kyi rje dpal ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug kun spangs sgyu ma'i gar mkhan gyi rmad byung gi mdzad pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ngo mtshar dad pa'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmor dus kun tu phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyab bdag gdod ma'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*// bde chen rnam rol gar gyis mngon par mdzes// rnam dag dri med kun khyab srid zhi'i dpal/ mtshungs med bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas// phan bde rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas nyid gyur te// grangs med 'gro ba (17na33)kun gyi skyabs gcig bu// ma lus 'dren pa mchog der gsol ba 'debs// yang dag ye shes mngon du rab gyur nas/ gdul bya rgya mtsho'i blo dang legs 'tshams pa'i// dpag med sprul pas thub bstan rgyas mdzad pa// bgrang yas thugs rje'i gter der gsol ba 'debs// zhing 'dir rgyal ba'i snying rje las 'khrungs sku/ mi tra'i mtshan can rje btsun skye med sogs// phul byung rnam 'phrul sna tshogs legs bstan nas/ rnam grol lam mchog ston der gsol ba 'debs// gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir gdul bya'i don slad du// rigs dang dus la brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ dge mtshan bya ba'i rtags dang lhan cig par// mngon par lhums su zhugs der gsol ba 'debs// sa bcu non phyir zla ba bcu bzhugs nas// yid 'phrog lha yi khab mtshungs mngon dga' bar// rje btsun bla ma rab tu bltams pa'i tshe// lhar bcas 'gro bas mchod der gsol ba 'debs// gzhon nu nyid nas rlabs chen spyod pa yi// zab mo'i bya bas dus kun rab 'da' ba// chung ngur gnas kyang chen po'i ngang tshul gyis// 'gro kun ngo mtshar skye der gsol ba 'debs// sngon sbyangs mthu yis shes bya'i gnas kun kyang*// mthong ba'i mod la ji bzhin rab rtogs nas// chos phung rgya mtsho'i tshig don 'byed mkhas pa// 'gran med bla ma mchog de da gsol ba 'debs// srid 'di'i sgyu thabs rnam par bkra ba yang*// mkha' yi 'ja' bzhin snying po med gzigs te// mi rtag 'ching ba'i bya ba kun spangs nas// bstan la mngon par byung der gsol ba 'debs// bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes gzung nas// smin dang grol ba'i gdams pa ji snyed pa// dang bstan bcos ma lus rab 'doms pa'i// zab rgyas chos kyi gter der gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i bsti gnas dben pa'i ri sul du// mi rtog ting 'dzin mchog la snyoms zhugs nas// bdud sde rtsa lag bcas pa kun bcom pa// 'jigs brel dpa' bo che der gsol ba 'debs// (17ba34)'khor lo sdom pa rje btsun rnal 'byor sogs// lhag pa'i lha mchog grangs med zhal gzigs nas// rjes gzung lung bstan dbang bzhis smin mdzad pa'i/

rgyal sras kun gyi gtso der gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha'i mtha' klas rgyal ba gzhal med kyis// brtse ba'i phyag gis mngon par dbang bskur nas// mi nyams chos kyi rgyal srid legs gtad pa// ston pa'i rgyal tshab zhabs der gsol ba 'debs// gang gi mkhyen rab rtag sdod khyon ltar phangs// thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i rmongs pa sel// phyogs dang ris med bshad sgrub pad tshal skyong*// snyigs dus lus can mgon der gsol ba 'debs/ mi zad gsung gi chos sgra cher bsgrags pas// dad ldan 'bum phrag du ma tshim byed cing*// dam pa'i lam la 'god mkhas thugs rje can// lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyan der gsol ba 'debs// mkhas grub skye dgu kun gyi spyi bor// zhabs zung padmo mngon par chags gyur nas// dang bas srol chen phyogs mthar rgyas mdzad pa// yongs kyi gtsug rgyan gang der gsol ba 'debs// shes dang shes bya ma lus thugs su chud// rgya chen gsung rab rgya mtsho'i dbang gcig pu// snying po'i nges gsang kho na rtag sgrogs pa// theg mchog chos kyi mdzod der gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i gzugs// byang sems rlabs chen mtshan pa'i tshul gzung ba// skyabs gsum mchog gyur skyabs med rnams kyi mgon// mnyam med skyob pa mchog der gsol ba 'debs// mthong dang thos pa'i skye bo ma lus pa'i// sgo gsum nyes pa mtha' dag rab zhi nas// mi shigs phyag rgya che la dbang sbyor ba'i// mthong thos dran reg gyur der gsol ba 'debs// sgyu ma'i sprul pas sgyu ma'i don mdzad nas// mi rtag sgyu mas tshul bstan phyir// sgyu ma'i gang mkhan sgyu ma'i dbyings su gshegs// rtag 'dzin sgyu mar ston der gsol ba 'debs// 'ja' 'od gur khang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// sa dang ri bo chu gter kun g.yos shing*// bde ldan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mdun (18na35)bltas nas/

dang pas mngon par mchod der gsol ba 'debs// rin chen gtsug ldan 'chi med 'khor bcas kyis// 'od zer lnga ldan gyen 'gros legs ma chod pas// rin chen gandho'i tshul du ra 'phags te// ngo mtshar ring bsrel stsol der gsol ba 'debs// de ltar dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma mchog /bdag sogs dad pas dus kun gsol btab pas/ tshe rabs kun tu khyod kyis rjes gzung ste// thugs kyi sras mchog dam pa nyid gyur cig /bslab pa gsum ldan 'phags pa'i nor ma la shes pa mngon gyur nas// sku bzhi'i rgyal srid chen po thob gyur cig /ces pa rje btsun de nyid kyi chos las skyes pa dge slong skad gnyis smra ba dbyangs can 'phreng sde dang*/ sgrub pa ba chos 'khor rnam rgyal gnyis kyis nan du bskul ba'i ngor/ mi pham padma dkar po phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bstod pa'o/// /yang*/ shes dang shes bya gnyis su med pa'i sku// rab 'byams chos kun cig car 'doms pa'i gsung*// rgya che zab mo'i thugs mnga' rin po che'i// mtsho ltar yid bzhin 'byung gnas de la 'dud// mtshan spel lo/// /gu ru mtshan brgyad la bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// rab dkar kun bzang thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i mtshor// rnam rol rgyal rnams thugs rje'i bde sdong gis// bskrun pas bgrang yas 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// khengs ldan yid srungs dpung las rnam rgyal ba'i// mchog gi la dbang bskur brnyes gyur nas// (18ba36)phan bde'i rgyal ba thabs ci yang bsgyur ba yi// padma rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba'i bstan la gang gis mdzad pa'i phul// ston pa nyid dang rnam par mi phyed pa'i// grags pa'i bdan srid pa'i mthar skyong ba// shākya ge'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// shes bya'i chos rnams kun gyi rgya mtsho che// rnam dpyod khyor ba gcig gis 'thungs pa slar// 'gro ba'i yid bzhin 'bebs mkhas drang srong dbang*// blo ldan mchog sred zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// grub rang rig 'dzin kun gyi zur phud rir// zhabs sen zla tshes gsar pa legs bkod nas// skye dgu'i nad kyi gdung ba 'dzoms mdzad pa'i// padma sambha'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gang gis rtag par 'jig rten gsum po 'di'i// mi bzad rmongs pa'i rab rib kun phrogs nas// snang ba mchog gi skal ba dger mdzad pa'i// nyi ma 'od zer zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phas rgol bdud dang mu stegs wa skyes kyi// snying rnams cig car mgrin par 'byin byed pa// zab dang rgya che'i sde ji snyed kyi// seng ge sgra sgrogs zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// stobs ldan bgegs dang log 'dren rnams kyi g.yul// mtshan tsam bsgrags pas rmeg med 'joms nus pa'i// stobs ldan dbang phyug kun gyi bdag po ni// rdo rje gro lod zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag ni skyabs gzhan spangs nas khyod kho na'i// zhabs pad 'di nas gzung ste gar skyes sar// mchod do mgon nyid gang du gshegs pa'i sar// myur bar khrid cig gu ru rin po che// zhes mtshan brgyad gsol 'debs 'di chos skyong ba'i sbyin bdag dang*/

gnubs kyi sngags 'chang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i ngor// rig pa 'dzin pa padma dkar pos lho brag mkhar chur sbyar ba'o/// /rngog lo blo ldan shes rab la bstod pa// lung dang rigs pa smra ba thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu rngog lo tsa ba blo ldan shes rab kyi zhabs kyi padmor phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rgya gar rgya nag bod dang li yul gyi/ mkhas (19na37)shing mkhas pa'i rigs pa smra ba tsho'i// gtsug gi nor bu'i zhabs sen nyer mchod pa// blo ldan shes rab zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// khyod kyi yon tan nam mkha'i kho na khyab pa// phyogs rnams kun tu gsal bar rig pa yis// gzhan gyi yon tan cung zad yod pa rnams// 'phro ba'i go skabs med pa bzhin du byas// blo ldan nyid byed khyod dang ma phrang na// bod yul rmongs pa'i mun pa mthar byed ni// su zhes byed pa'i 'bad pa stong phrag gis// thugs rje'i shing rtas khyod 'dir drangs pa snyam// 'chad pa seng ge'i khri la legs 'khod nas// gzhung lugs 'bum phrag du ma'i srol phye ste// blo gsal mang po mkhas pa'i sar bkri bas// ston pa gnyis par grags so lo tsa ba// smra ba'i ra bar khyod ni yang dang yang*// la gnyis rnam par brkyang nas rtsod pa'i tshe// phas rgol mkhas pa'i dregs ldan ma lus pa// rmongs nas mi smra'i brtul zhugs len par byed// rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi// gzhung lugs brgya phrag mang po rnam phye nas// tshes lam bzhag tshe tshangs pa rig byed tsam// dran pa'i khengs pa de nas bskyur ba bzhin// 'don dang 'di dang 'dzin par 'dod pa yi// blo gsal blo yi padmo 'byed pa la// blo ldan nyin mor byed khyod lhag par du// grags pa'i gur kum 'gro 'di'i rna bar 'dzin// da lta'ang thos pa 'dzin par 'dod pa rnams// gus pa'i mig 'bras khyod la phyogs pa ni// bshes gnyen skyabs gzhan bral ba dag la khyod// skye bar mgon du gyur ces gnas pa snyam// gang la brton nas phas rgol gnyis 'thung la// 'chi ba'i 'jigs ster smra ba'i seng ger ni// nges par 'gyur mdzad 'jam mnyen chu skyes zhabs// bdag gi spyi bor rtag par bzhag tu gsol// yongs 'du'i shing dang yid bzhin nor bu ltar// thugs rje can khyod lus can thams cad la// 'bad pa med par mngon par mtho ba dang*// nges par legs pa'i dpal rnams sbyin par mdzod// mang du thos pa'i snyan ngags mkhan gnas brtan bsod snyoms pa padma dkar pos yul lho phyogs kyi (19ba38)rgyud bkra shis mthong smon gyi chos grwar/

lo tsa ba chen po la mi phyed pa'i dad pas phyag bgyi ba dang lhan cig par sbyar ba'o/// /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa la bstod pa/ lung dang rigs pa smra ba thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu bu ston lo tsa ba chen po rin chen grub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbus na zla med pa'i// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rin chen 'dod dgu'i tshogs// yid bzhin grub mdzad gang der dang ba'i blos// gus par phyag 'tshal kun nas skyabs su mchi// sgra rig bstan bcos kun la khyod byang zhing*// lhag par 'dris pas rang las lhag mthong nas// lha yi drang srong rgan po phur bu de// mkhas pa'i nga rgyal bskyangs te gnas pa bzhin// mdo dang sde bdun pa'i gzhung kun la// smra ba'i dbang por gyur khyod phyogs gang gis// chos kyi grags pa phas kyi rgol ba la// mi smra'i brtul zhugs ster bar bkod pa bzhin// bzo dang zlos gar lugs kyi shes bya la// srid 'dir khyod dang mtshungs pa ma rnyed nas// 'jig rten byed po rang gis ma byas pa'i// ya mtshan ci las byung zhes bsam pas brel// sman gyi dpyad la 'tsho mdzad gzhon nu dang*// shes pa'i tshul la khyad par 'ga' med pa// khyed nyid gcig pur grags pas rgyun shes bu// de tshas zhum nas thim pa snyam// mdo sde rgyal ba'i yum gyi mdo rnams kun// rang gi bstan bcos ji bzhin 'chad par khyod// gzigs nas rgyal ba'i tshab ma pham pa// dga' ldan gnas su bde bar ngal bso mdzad// mya mtsho lta bu'i mngon pa'i chos sde rnams// tshig don khong du chud nas ston mdzad khyod// thogs med zhabs dang dbyig gnyen gang yin zhes// blo gsal phal cher the tshom gnas su gyur// 'dul ba 'bum sde'i gzhung dang dgongs 'grel rnams// shin tu sbyangs pas 'chugs med mkhyen gyur nas// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la gnas khyod dang yon tan shākya 'od min su/

lta ba'i ri bo bsnyil ba'i rigs (20na39)pa'i tshogs// ding sang gzhan dang gzhan du bkral gzigs nas// ji lta de ltar 'chad pa khyod kyis ni// klu grub yab sras brdzus te phebs pa bzhin// rig 'dzin sde snod kun gyi rdo rje'i tshig /ma nor phye nas dngos nyid 'doms mkhas pas// grub pa'i dbang phyug khyod dang rgyal rnams kyi// gsang ba'i bdag po gnyis la khyad par ci// chos rje bla ma bu ston lo tsa ba// khyed la re bltos bcas pa'i bu slob rnams// rig gnas kun la mkhas shing mkhas pa yi// rgyal ba'i thos pa 'dzin pa'i mchog gyur cig /gang la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa chos smra ba'i dge slong padma dkar pos bod yul lho dogs kyi rgyal khams chos grwa chen po bkra shis mthong smon du sbyar ba'o/// /'jam dbyangs dkar po'i bstod pa bzhugs// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba rnams la yongs 'dzin bla ma dang*// mkha' mnyam 'gro la byams pa'i gnyen dang ni// thar 'dod rnams la dge ba'i bshes gcig pu// 'jam pa'i dbyangs der dad pas bstod par bgyi// baṃ yig las 'khrungs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ni// me tog mgo lcogs ldem pa'i lding khang na// chu bya gzhon nu snyan pa'i glu len pas// gang ba'i rba rlabs g.yo der phyag 'tshal lo// 'jug ngogs yangs pa'i ne'u gsing mthon ka'i steng*// gangs ri'i dum bu chad rnams rgyu ba bzhin// bung ba'i 'phreng 'dzin gnyis 'thung dbang po'i khyus// dog par bgyis der dang bas phyag bgyi'o// phyogs kyi khong rnams dri bsung zhim po yis// gang ba'i spos kyi khang pa ltar bgyid pa'i// paṃ las byung ba'i dbyibs mdzes padma dang*// bsil zer gdan kyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo// a dkar las 'khrungs blo gros 'dab brgya'i gnyen// snying stobs rgyas pa'i tsha zer dra ba can// rdzogs sangs mkhyen pa'i mkha' yi dpal gcig pu// 'jam mgon nyin mor byed la phyag 'tshal lo// rab dkar 'od zer dbus na skyil krung gis// bzhugs pa bcu drug (20ba40)lang tshos mdzes pa'i sku// bsil zer pa tra'i khongs kyi zla ris bzhin// blta bas ngoms pa med der phyag 'tshal lo// smin 'khyogs utpal sngon po'i gzhu bkang nas/

yangs pa'i mthon mthing zur mig mda' rnon ni// gang du 'phangs der mi shes gi yul gyi tshogs// ming tsam lhag mar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// shangs rgyud mdzes pa dpe las 'gongs mthong nas// byed po rmongs la cung zad 'dzum 'dra ba'i// ma mchu'i dmar bas ban dhū dzi ba ka'i// khengs pa thams cad phrogs der phyag 'tshal lo// mthon mthing dbu skra zur phud lngas bcings pa'i// rtse mor yid bzhin nor bu rnams 'dzin pa// sngo bsangs bu mo bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar dang*// 'grogs pa phun tshogs mtshungs der phyag 'tshal lo// dri med rna shal nor bu'i rna chad nga*// snyan gong dar dbyangs utpal mthing kha'i rgyan// zla shel 'khri shing yal ga'i 'dab ma ni// ind+ra nī las byas 'drar phyag 'tshal lo// mu tig ljon shing sna tshogs nor bu yi// me tog ge sar g.yo ba'i phra tshom can// ci yang 'khod pa'i mgul gyi skyed mos tshal// mig la bdud rtsi'i rgyun der phyag 'tshal lo// do shar sprin gyi 'phreng ba chu ris can// 'od zer glog 'gyu'i rlabs kyis rtag bran pas// rnam dkris sku stod rgyas pa'i 'bigs byed ri// thar 'dod dpyid ka'i dpal der phyag 'tshal lo// phyag g.yas dkar 'jam me tog 'dzum pa'i kha/ mchog sbyin phyag rgya'i ge sar g.yo ba nas// gdul bya kun gyi yid la re ba yi// rdul gsar ci yang 'thor der phyag 'tshal lo// phyag g.yon pad rdzing dngal gyi utpal// rab dkar 'dab ma yangs pa'i ze'u 'bru'i// snying po stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam gyis// rnam par mdzes par bgyis la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag zhabs sked skabs brgyan de'i gser gyi 'od// phyogs kyi bu mo'i gdong la gur kum chus// rol pa'i pa tra chu shing bris 'dra ba'i// ya mtshan ci yang 'dzin der phyag 'tshal lo// stod g.yogs (21na41)du ku la yi gos dkar gyi// pañtsa li ka'i smad g.yogs man pas pas ni// gangs ri'i dbang pos brgya byin mtshon gzung nas// zla bar 'gran 'dra gang der phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi sku ni mthong ngam yid kyis dran// mtshan tsam thos pas de yi rmongs pa'i tshogs// srog dang bral bar mdzad pa'i lhag pa'i lha// gegs med blta bar 'dod do 'jam pa'i dbyangs// 'di nas gzung nas byang chub snying po'i bar// gang du skye ba'i bla mar khyod gyur nas// gtsug lag kun la mkhas pa'i gnas thob ste// rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin cing bsgrub par shog

/mgon khyod kun gzigs gang du sangs rgyas pa'i// zhing de'i rgyal tshab dam par bdag gyur nas// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba thams cad kun mkhyen gyi// go 'phang bla na med der 'god gyur cig /padma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba'o/// /rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la bstod pa bzhugs// bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs rje'i bdud rtsi yi// chu gter gyis spros zla ba rgyal ba'i yum// rmongs pa'i mun 'phrags snying stobs ku mu ta// ma lus 'byed pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dri med chu shel nor bu'i 'khri shing ni// ha ri tsan dan dog pas 'khyud 'dra ba'i// rab dkar yid 'phrog sgeg mo'i gzugs 'dzin ma// bcu drug lang tsho rgyas par phyag 'tshal lo// nu 'bur rgyas pa'i dpal 'bras kyis dud pa'i// lus phra mdzes sdug gsar pa'i 'khri shing ni// phyag zhabs chu skyes rgod pa'i ge sar la// mig gi bud bo g.yo bar phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen mthing gis mu tig do shar khongs// spras 'dra'i 'od can spyan gsum ri dgas mo// 'gying ba'i 'gros kyis glang po dman byed pa// yid 'od mdzes pa'i snying por phyag 'tshal lo// rtag par 'dzum pas mchu yis yal 'dab la// mu tig 'bras bu chags pas byu ru'i 'od// mdzes par 'god la shangs rgyud yid ris kyis// 'bod pas bzos 'dra gang la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen rnams dang (21ba42)me tog gis brgyan pa'i// lan bu gcig pa'i zur phud mthon mthing gis// sprin gsar tshogs la gdengs pa rma bya yi// mjug ma'i mdzes sdug 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// nye ma'i 'od zer ldan pa'i con pan gyis// legs spras snyan gong utpal mthing kha'i rgyan// chu shel ljon pa'i yal ga khu byug gi// gshog pa brkyang ba'i mdzes 'drar phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rgyan rin chen rab 'bar 'gram pa la// ya mtshan 'od ris ci yang bri ba ni// mkhur tshos dkar dmar mdangs kyis yid 'ong la// dal bas 'gran par bgyid der phyag 'tshal lo// mgul na mu tig chun po'i rgyun dag ni// shin tu rags pas mtshan mo'i dpal gyur pa'i// zla ba'i dkar ba ma lus 'phrog pa ltas// brgyan cing brgyan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dpung rgyan gdu bu dur ba'i 'phreng rgya ba// do shal gang gā'i lbu ba rab gsal gyis// mdzes shing rgod pa lha yi ri bo ni// gzi byin mtshungs pa med der phyag 'tshal lo// dzambhu na dī'i dril chung sgra 'byin pa'i// 'od zer rab rgyas nor bu'i ske rags dang*// mdzes 'dzum rlabs kyi gzugs brnyan gis bzang gis// rnam mdzes sgrol ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa utpa la'i// sdong po 'dzin cing skyil krung ngang mo ni// pad dkar myu gus mtshan pa'i zla ba'i mtshor// mdzes pas rnam par rol la phyag 'tshal lo// rus min 'chi ba nad dang 'jigs pa brgyad// dran pas yud tsam nyid la sel bgyid pa'i// yid bzhin 'khor los thugs ka rnam mdzes pa'i// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs kyi khongs rnams dri med 'od zer gyi// bdud rtsi'i rlabs kyis 'gongs bzod bcom ldan ma// khyod kyi bka' drin dag gis bdag cag gi// yid la 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par mdzod// dad pa'i thal sbyar mtshims mig brlan cing*// gdung bas yid bskul gsol 'debs nga ro ni// ku ra ri bzhin sgrog la thugs rje'i spyan// gzigs la le lo ma mdzad bcom ldan ma// zhes cho (22na43)'phrul gyi dus chen la dad pa'i blos sbyar ba'o/// /rje btsun ma sgrol ma sngon mo la bstod pa 'dod pa'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi dbang phyug ma// rgyal ba'i yum 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro la rjes chags pa'i// 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan yangs las 'khrungs shing*// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las pa// 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ma khyed la 'dud// ji ltar gzhal du med pa'i gzugs chen po'i// brnyan po chung ngu'i bkod mar 'jug pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams kyi rnyog bral zhi ba'i sku/

byis blo'i mtshor yang rang nyams bzhin 'char la/ ma rga ta zhun mas byugs kyang gser bzang gi/ 'od zer phyogs kyi dpal mo'i mthar 'gro ba'i// ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i rin chen yod dgu'i gzugs// bgrang yas 'gro ba kun gyi nyer 'tshor gyur// mthon mthing lcang lo'i lan tshar g.yo ba ni// snyan gong utpal gdengs ka la 'khyud pa// mkhar nyal bu mo'i skra tshogs ni tsa la'i// dog pa gsar ba'i 'phreng bas brten pa bzhin/ rang bzhin kun gsal mdzes mar snying rje yi// rgyu skar 'phreng ba spel mkhas srid pa'i sar// mdza' bo'i bsnyengs bcil slar yang bzhin ras la// mdzes pa'i 'ja' tshon spel bas su zhig 'gugs// khyod sku'i snang ba dge legs bye ba'i gter// dpe zlas 'phongs pa'i yi gar 'ong ba la// lha rdzas con pan rin chen mgu la rgyan dang*// rna chas 'ol spyir min pa'ang gsal por bstan// chos tshul inda nī la'i chu klung che// 'gro ba'i yid rjes g.yo ba'i rlabs 'phreng gis// srid mthar rgyu bas gang gis mgul gyi 'gram// nyer ka'i rim cung zad dod pa snyam// nu 'bur mun pa drungs 'byin 'od stong can// sku stod sked skabs 'gyid gi nam mkha' las// na dī'i ska rags sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rtser// lcang bar dogs pas 'og pag shar ris brten// dpal mo'i gzugs 'phos dri med (22ba44)nor bu yis// do shal 'phreng bar spel bsam smras kyang*// gdul bya'i mdza' bo sbron pa'i sil sil sgras// thar pa'i zla bzhin ma khyod snying la bris// 'gro ba'i ma ma khyod kyis ma bskyangs pa// lus can phan bde skal bas 'tsho ba su// de phyir phyag g.yas yid la brnab pa'i mchog /kun tu sbyin pa'i rgyu las g.yel ba min// myur skyobs sems can sgrol ba'i thugs dam ni// 'dul ba'i rkyen bzhin 'jug par mtshon pa la// phyag g.yon thugs kar mtheb srin sbyar ba'i rtser// utpal la mthon ka'i sdong bu rgyas pa 'dzin// 'phrin las yid bzhin dang ba'i rgyal mtshan rtser// mngon par mchod na ris med 'gro ba la// 'dod dgu ster ba'i brdar ni khyod kyi zhabs// bag tsam g.yas brkyang g.yon ni skyil krung nyid// yid srubs bu mo'i mig sman gyis byugs pas// chags ldan yid la bdud rtsir byed min kyang*// dag pa'i lus med khyod la dbang po'i gzhu// na bza'i zol gyis reg pa kun dga'i skyes// srid las rab grol stong nyid 'dab brgya'i gnyen// zhi bar mi gnas snying rje'i zlas khyab par// rab zhugs khyod la bskul ba med par yang*// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzad// gang gi yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' brjod par// mi spobs mod kyang dad pa'i chu rlangs kyis// bstod pa'i sprin 'phreng bkod la phan bde'i char// ci yang 'bab pa su yis bzlog par nus// khyod las 'jigs brgyad tsha gdung gtad bral ba'i// dad pa'i ku mu ta tshe nor shes rab sogs// phun tshogs dri bzang snyem rab dar ba'i// rnam grol zil dngar rgyas pa bdag gis slong*// gzhan yang bdag blo'i thub bstan dpag bsam shing*// lung rigs 'bras bu'i khur lcis dud bzhin du// bshad sgrub lo ma'i gos bzang legs 'phyur bas// srid pa'i ljongs 'di ma lus khyab gyur cig

/bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma sngon mo la dad pa'i stobs kyis bstod pa// blo gsal padma dkar pos gtsang shar kha'i yul gyi lte ba rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba'o/// /(23na45)drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po la bstod pa// chos thams cad kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rnam kun re khā ra bris kyang ma rnyogs shing*// bcu drug cha shas rdzogs kyang gshis nyid las// 'gyur med yan lag bdun ldan kha sbyor sku// shri he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs// gsang ba mchog gi gan dho la chen por// chos kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa rigs kun la// rtag par stob mkhas rdo rje 'chang chen po// dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bor gsol ba 'debs// gang gi rgyu mthun dri med shel gong mthu// 'gro rgyud mos pa kun la chags pa'i mdangs// phan bde'i pir du len mkhas shākya'i tog /mchog gi sprul sku ngo mar gsol ba 'debs// rtsa rnams dbu mar sbyangs ba'i zhing rnams su// nyi zla 'dres pa'i shing rta la zhon nas// khams kyi dngas ma'i 'gros gnyis rdzogs pa'i mtha'i// phyag rgya chen po 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po la padma dkar pos dpal tsā ri tra cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i gur khang du bstod pa dge legs su gyur cig// /slob dpon tilli pa la bstod pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'char gzhi rje btsun tilli pa'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan snang mdzad sras kyi thu bo pa// kun tu bzang po rgyal ba'i mthu stobs kyis// rdo rje lag na 'dzin de bhaṃ ga lar// bram ze gsal 'od sprul pa de la 'dud// ḍā ki'i rgya mtsho'i rdo rje yan lag ma// shes rab mar rnyed mthu yis 'dzam gling gi// bstan pa'i chu bo bzhi bsdus 'og min gnas// gangs chen longs spyod bzang pos 'tsho der 'dud// mkha' mnyam gdul bya'i nyon mongs til brdungs nas// rnam grol mar khu 'byin la sna tshogs gzugs// sna tshogs skad dang sna tshogs thugs 'char ba// zag med chos sde'i rang bzhin de la 'dud// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar dag tu// khyod la bstod pa'i go skabs de ring (23ba46)tsam// da ni khyod kyi thugs rje'i skyo thang gis// zin pas phyir ldog yongs snyam ma mchis so// 'on kyang 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// phrag dog nga rgyal rnams la sngar 'dris pas// bag med 'gyur srid der yang mgon po khyod// bsnyeg med pas bdag cag skyabs su gsol/// /jo bo nā ro pa la bstod pa/

lnga rig pa'i dge sbyor chen po chos kyi spyan can brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pa dpal nā ro pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i sgyu ma ni// kha cher nā ro ta pa'i cho rigs rtser// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar gar stabs su// sbyor brtse dga'i 'khri shing de la 'dud// chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng tshe 'jig rten na// chos bzhin rtsod par nus med 'jigs med zhes// skyabs kyi bla ma gnyis par grags pa yi// gnas brtan bstan pa 'dzin pa'i mchog der 'dud// bcu gnyis khyim bsnyen tilli ye shes zla// bdud rtsir 'dzag pa khyod dngos la reg des// gangs can rgya mtsho go rim de de'i mod// snyan grags bzang po khor yug brdal la 'dud// rnam gnon ngang tshul sogs su gdul bya'i ngor// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo skyong la// gzhan du brtul zhugs spyod mdzad me mur// kha spyod rdo rje 'chang du rdzogs der 'dud// de ltar rje btsun khyod la bstod pa'i mthus// 'di nas gzung ste rdo rje 'chang thob par// khyod kyi zhabs bsten gsung bsgrub khyod bzhin du// ma lus 'gro ba'i don la 'jug par shog /mchog gzigs gnyis kyi bsdod pa mthu stobs zhabs kyi dam tshig gis bsdus pa'i grogs yon tan bzang pos bskul ba dang*/ rang nyid mos pa'i shugs kyis rje btsun ras chung pa mkha' spyod la byon sa tshe skod dpal gyi phug par padma dkar pos rje btsun nyid kyi mtshan rnam thar rjes su dran pa'i rkyen du sbyar ba'o/// /rgod tshang pa bu brgyud dang bcas pa la bstod pa/ stong 'brug gnam gyi skar ma lta bu zhes lha dang bcas pa'i mchod sdong chen po'i ston pa mgon po rdo rje'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sa gsum (24na47)'gro ba kun gyi mgon po mchog /rdo rje 'chang ba sgyu 'phrul rigs brgya'i dpyid// dpal ldan grub pa'i thig ler shar ba ni// rgod tshang par grags chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud// lho brag dol bu chung gi khrar 'khrungs shing*// gzhon nu nyid nas sngon sbyangs sad pa'i mthus// chos rje'i mtshan thos drung du chos la byon// bco brgyad zhag gis bden pa gzigs la 'dud// sangs rgyas dbon las thos pa'i phul bsgrubs nas// tsa rir thogs med bag chags phal bkrus te// dzā lan dha ra sogs su spyod pa'i shugs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dbus ngoms pa de la 'dud// gangs ri ti ser rten 'brel gzigs mo shar// rgyal gyi shrī rir sgrub pa'i srol gzung tshe// mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs mkhas pa'i dbang por byon// mchog grub rdzu 'phrul gter 'don mdzad la 'dud// yang dgon u rgyan ne rings spyir dkar ba// de sogs grub chen brnyes pa rgyu skar tsam// mos
